description: This PHP source file defines a class `ViewModulelabels` that extends `SugarView`. It appears to handle the display of module labels within the SuiteCRM Module Builder interface, including preparing Smarty templates with language-specific labels and managing breadcrumb navigation with Ajax. The class includes methods for retrieving module title parameters and rendering the view, interacting with various SuiteCRM components such as ModuleBuilder, Smarty templates, and Ajax handling.
